en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque on the left and an equestrian statue on a high pedestal in the middle foreground. People are sitting on steps and walking around the square, with multi‑storey historic buildings and a distant church tower in the background. The reverse features Hungarian text, address lines, a green Hungarian stamp, and printed information about the place.
